description: On a writable copy of the qd fixture, each saved action QueryDef (QUpd, QDel, QApp, QMake) is looked up and run with QueryDef.Execute; after each run QueryDef.RecordsAffected and Database.RecordsAffected are read. Afterwards the rows of T, W and TNew are read (the TNew open is attempted whether or not QMake created it).
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
